selection_order: higher live-meta W/L gain versus CR024
fewer live-meta W/L regressions versus CR024
higher fresh pairwise score versus CR024
higher head-to-head score against the other finalist
higher live-meta mean delta gain versus CR024
notes: Official source episodes are selected by manifest avg_score only, then require exact terminal tape reproduction and unique winner-tape SHA256.
Episode/team/submission identity is evaluation-only and is never exposed to any runtime agent.
All official-meta games use the source episode seed and configuration and test both candidate seats.
Fresh pairwise seeds are firewalled against seed values in every other JSON config in configs/.
No held-out set and no automatic Kaggle submission are used.
